I want to create a toy car model. Create a box with dimensions 200x100x100(X,Y,Z) as the body. The windshield can be created by subtracting a 50x100x50 block from an upper edge of the box. Add four wheels with a radius of 25 and a thickness of 10: Place two at (25,0,0) and (175,0,0) facing in the Y-Axis (0,1,0), and two at (25,100,0) and (175,100,0) facing in the negative Y-Axis (0,-1,0). | First, describe in words and step by step how the user's request can be implemented using function calls only. After the description, I will ask you to prepare the function call for execution, but don't execute it until I explicitly request it.

Step-by-step implementation plan (only describing what the later function calls will do):

1 – Main body  
• Use a single block(…) call with  
  – x_size = [200], y_size = [100], z_size = [100]  
  – x = [0], y = [0], z = [0] (the block starts at the global origin)  
  – subtraction = [False] (first volume, so it is added).

2 – Windshield cut-out  
• A second block(…) call to subtract a 50 × 100 × 50 volume from the front-upper corner:  
  – x_size = [50], y_size = [100], z_size = [50]  
  – x = [150], y = [0], z = [50] (start point puts it on the last 50 mm in X and the top half in Z)  
  – subtraction = [True] (subtracts this volume from the body).

3 – Wheels (four cylinders)  
Each wheel is a cylinder with radius = 25 and axial length (thickness) = 10.  
• Front-left wheel (outer face at y = 0)  
  – cylinder(…) with baseCenter (25, 0, 25), heightVect (0, 10, 0) (axis points +Y)  
• Front-right wheel (outer face at y = 100)  
  – cylinder(…) with baseCenter (25, 100, 25), heightVect (0, −10, 0) (axis points –Y)  
• Rear-left wheel  
  – cylinder(…) with baseCenter (175, 0, 25), heightVect (0, 10, 0)  
• Rear-right wheel  
  – cylinder(…) with baseCenter (175, 100, 25), heightVect (0, −10, 0)

For every cylinder call, set radius = [25], subtraction = [False] (we want to add the wheels) and, if desired, cylinder_func = [1] to mark them as force-application objects.

4 – Finalization  
• After the four cylinder(…) calls, execute finished(allFunctionsCalled = true).
